messages:
ana: Heads-up: onboarding sample app triggers a client-side stampede when users run bulk imports. Steps: spawn 8 concurrent pagers + token refresh shortly after token expiry. Results in burst retries and 429s.

li: I saw the same in staging. The JS SDK creates new page tasks without concurrency caps and the refresh promise pauses auth flow but doesn't gate new requests.

tom: Do we have a consistent strategy across SDKs? Go and Py handled this differently last time.

rachel: Py SDK uses a single-flight refresh + queueing for new requests. Go opts for parallel refresh with per-request jitter. Neither is ideal.

ana: (typo) rachel -> ana: Thanks. We should pick a default that minimizes surprise for newbies. Queueing + a small permissive parallel cap sounds right.

infra-bot: Note: quota alert threshold hit for sample-customer-12 at 2025-10-12T14:03Z. 429 rate jumped to 18/min.

li: Proposal: add `client.window` options to sample config: { maxParallelPages: 4, authStrategy: 'queue', retryPolicy: { base: 120, cap: 2000, jitter: 50 } } and wire AbortController so queued tasks cancel cleanly.

tom: Implementation nit: prefer semaphore pattern over naive queue to avoid memory accumulation. Example snippet for JS:
```js
class Semaphore {
  constructor(n){ this.n=n; this.waiters=[] }
  acquire(){ if(this.n>0){ this.n--; return Promise.resolve() } return new Promise(r=>this.waiters.push(r)) }
  release(){ this.n++; if(this.waiters.length) this.n--, this.waiters.shift()() }
}
```

rachel: Also add randomized post-refresh drain window: sleep(rand(50,200)) before retrying queued requests. That small spread smooths bursts.

ana: We should include a short example in the onboarding README and a test harness in the repo that simulates 500-row imports to catch regressions.

li: I'll patch sampleapp and add E2E smoke test. Will also file SDK parity tickets: JS to adopt single-flight+queue, Go to add optional queue mode.

sdk-team: Can we standardize env var names so ops can tune without code changes? Suggest: RW_MAX_PARALLEL_PAGES, RW_AUTH_STRATEGY, RW_RETRY_BASE_MS.

ana: Good idea. Add section to docs/onboarding.md explaining tuning knobs and guidance: "Start low (2-4) for first-run importers, ramp up if memory/quotas allow."

infra-bot: Patch landed in sampleapp: staging v0.5.1 (sha: c0ffee). Canary shows 0 429s in 1k import sim with maxParallelPages=4.

tom: Great. Follow-ups: docs PR, JS SDK PR for authStrategy, Go SDK ticket. I'll own the Go ticket.

ana: Thanks team 44d. Let's make sure we add a simple telemetry metric for client-side backpressure so we can detect misconfigurations early.

sdk-team: Agreed. Adding metric: sdk.client.backpressure.count and sdk.client.queue.length to tracking board.
